title: Pregnant Solo #37
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Spanish woman, an adult, in her mid 20s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward from her long, powerful torso, its surface taut and round, with a slight inward taper still visible at her waist on either side of the belly. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 200 bars piercings set with opals in bronze-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of rose-gold an anklet. Full body painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain, a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the pattern reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of tiered lotus-petal work wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's natural centrepiece, the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme gold extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
